_about: Every image file allowed on a Cubby screen, and where it came from. The founder's rule (2026-11-13): the painted cub made with ChatGPT is the standard image, no drawn bear and no emoji bear anywhere. tools/brand_image_check.js holds the tree to this list, statically and in a browser. A new picture is a deliberate edit here: `node tools/brand_image_check.js --hash <file>` prints the line to add.

master.name: deep-brown
master.provenance: gpt-image-2 deep-brown teddy from the W2+ master, founder pick A + rim + light/shade, 2026-11-15

families.name: Icons from the master
families.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: the master (see `master` above), made into every size by tools/gen_brand_icons.py: plain Lanczos resizes, except the maskable icon, which shrinks the bear (cut from its wash) onto the master's own wash inside the safe circle. Nothing is drawn. icons/logo-96.png and logo-192.png (2026-11-14) are the site's top-bar logo, 1x-2x and 3x. tools/brand.py set re-hashes this family when the master changes.

families.name: Spot art
families.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: gpt-image-2 cubs anchored to the hero (ae620fa9, 2026-08-02; re-baked 5a13dd95 and 61614655), the balloon 21e33bda (gpt-image-2, docs/poster-art-brief.md).

families.name: Journey (Moments) art
families.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: the founder's ChatGPT watercolour library (f4db3d3a and the batches after it), gap-fills and repaints in gpt-image-2 (b87b1f18, e4fa28c6), captions composited by tools/compose_cards.js. ov_* are the same art as keepsake overlays (deb46a6e).

families.name: Avatars
families.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: eighteen painted portraits from gpt-image (61614655, docs/plans/2026-08-07-painted-avatars.md).

families.name: Birth poster art
families.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: gpt-image-2 in the journey library's hand (7359a69f, 6ac7665b, f4a12851, 21e33bda; prompts in docs/poster-art-jobs.json).

families.name: App screenshots in the web manifest
families.provenance: Screenshots of the real app (tools/gen_manifest_shots.js); the only art in them is the painted avatars.

families.name: Text cards carrying the master
families.provenance: Typographic cards drawn by Pillow (tools/gen_article_img.py, gen_ph_gallery.py, gen_pwa_screenshots.py) and the social quote template (social/card-quote.html). Their only picture is the master logo, swapped in by tools/card_logo.py (2026-11-13 in place of a drawn bear, 2026-11-14 the W2+ master in place of the white cub, and the social quote card's footer since 2026-11-14 too); no other pixel changed. tools/brand.py set re-hashes this family when the master changes.

families.name: Article share cards
families.provenance: Same as the text cards: tools/gen_article_img.py, master logo swapped in by tools/card_logo.py.

families.name: Article hero cards
families.provenance: Same as the text cards: tools/gen_article_img.py, master logo swapped in by tools/card_logo.py. Shown at the top of 140 article pages.

inline.provenance: ChatGPT painted art: the offline balloon, inlined so the offline page cannot fail in pieces.

ui_glyphs: Inline SVG and data:image/svg+xml line icons (the I.* set, 24 grid, stroke 2) are UI, not pictures. An inline SVG with five or more filled circles or ellipses and no text is a drawn picture and fails.
runtime: Pictures people add (photos, keepsake canvases) arrive as blob:, data: or Firebase Storage URLs the app builds at runtime. They are not brand art and are out of scope.

needs_founder_decision.why: Twelve hand-coded SVG mock-ups of app screens, drawn as code rather than painted or captured, shown inside twelve 'cubby-*' article pages (e.g. /articles/cubby-family-circle/). Not brand art and not ChatGPT-made. The emoji bears in family-circle.svg are gone (initials now); the drawings are otherwise unchanged. Keep them, or replace each with a real 390px screenshot of the app?

Moments cards 023 and 024 share one illustration (art-src/023_pregnancy_one_month_pregnant.png). Commit b87b1f18 says Gemini (Nano Banana) made ONE image before it ran out of credit, and 023 was the first job in art-src/gapfill-jobs.json, so this is very likely the one picture in the library that ChatGPT did not paint. Unchanged. Keep it, or repaint it in ChatGPT?

The six App Store screenshots (09024bf5, 2026-08-21) still show emoji bears ("Good morning 🐻", "🐻 Today's recap", a 🐻 vaccine-card icon and medicine coach). docs/ is never served, so no web screen shows them, but they are the next App Store listing. Re-shoot them from the merged branch before the next submission?

retired.name: the June flat face
retired.why: The FLAT brown face generate_icons.py drew with Pillow (55e166ca, June 2026). Its bytes may never appear in the tree again. Hashed from 866851ac.

retired.name: the November white cub
retired.why: The white cub's face on flat honey (gpt-image-2, master 36154185, 2026-11-13), every icon resized from it and the fourteen text cards that carried it. Retired 2026-11-14: its face-to-background contrast measured 1.2:1 and the founder chose W2+. Hashed from c1fb604a. The 660 share cards and 571 heroes that carried it are held by tools/card_logo.py --check (any logo box that is not the current master's fails) and by their pinned digests.

retired.name: the W2+ painted teddy
retired.why: The master from 2026-11-14, retired 2026-11-15 by tools/brand.py set when deep-brown replaced it: its master and every icon and text card made from it, hashed before the change. The share cards and heroes that carried it are held by tools/card_logo.py --check (any logo box that is not the current master's fails) and their pinned digests.
